dogecoin.text: Dogecoin has reached a market cap of approximately $30 billion, making it the #1 memecoin by market capitalization. This surge has placed it among the top cryptocurrencies by market value, even surpassing XRP temporarily to claim the number 7 spot at one point. https://t.co/meLeKl1gVi

Meme Coins & Altcoins: Solana (SOL) and Dogecoin (DOGE) have led the altcoin rally, with DOGE's price movements hinting at a possible repeat of the late 2020 surge. Meanwhile, Cardano's ADA and Polygon's POL have also seen notable gains.
